page.overview:
Who is Canolo?

Canolo is a traveler who can be found in . She was previously traveling with her friends , , , and . However, the five of them were attacked by along the and ended up separated.

At , can find , who managed to escape. He asks to let and the rest of his friends know that he is waiting for them at the . This initiates the "" .

When she makes it to the , calls a and thanks for saving her. She admits that she did not know traveling could be so dangerous, as it was not mentioned in the guidebook she read. Having decided traveling is not for her, plans on heading back home after she rests. However, she has a feeling does not have the option to go home, so she wishes him well.
